categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Cases resolved directly through payment without enforcement steps, advancing 'Maximize timely fine revenue' and 'Minimize administrative & enforcement cost', judged against indicator 'Time to fine dispatch (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=12, supported by variants such as V0002 where payment occurs shortly after fine creation.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Cases where payment occurs later, after penalties or notifications, advancing 'Maximize timely fine revenue', judged against average closure time indicators.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=13, evidenced by variants like V0004 and V0006 where payment follows fine notifications and added penalties.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Cases involving administrative appeals submitted to the Prefecture, preserving due process rights while impacting administrative costs, judged against 'Time to appeal filing, Prefecture (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=14, supported by variants such as V0008, V0057, and V0135 that explicitly contain administrative appeal steps.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Cases involving judicial appeals to a judge, strongly preserving due process rights and hurting administrative cost reduction, judged against 'Time to appeal filing, Judge (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=19, observed in variants such as V0103, V0176, and V0140 containing judicial appeal actions.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Cases that fail voluntary resolution and are sent for coercive credit collection, maximizing revenue while hurting cost minimization, judged against case closure indicators.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=20, backed by high-duration variants such as V0001, V0009, and V0134 culminating in credit collection.
